title: The Bell Cellar
_note: Sparse cave cue for the Bell Cellar (the deep-cave rule: bare 4 voices, rendered in the snes register for its slow tempo and reverb). A low wave drone on A, a slow tolling bell that spells the first four notes of the Lantern Lullaby (G-C-D-E, here E-A-B-C in A minor) one note every two bars like a bell under water, single triangle drips, and a sparse pulse12 echo of the lullaby's turn. 66 BPM, 16-bar loop.
